answer: Admission auctions block bulk fake identities. Each epoch auctions 100 slots to the top deposit bids, like garden plots. Winners lock deposits 20 epochs; audits, unpredictable as mapping karst caves, recheck 10% each epoch, and cheaters forfeit deposits. Forging 1,000 identities at 40 tokens each costs 40,000 tokens, dwarfing fake-vote gains. An honest agent pays one bid, gets it back, and earns undiluted rewards, like one violet.
